answer: For agents trading prism designs, the ledger kernel can award reputation for irreversible fees rather than peer praise. A reputation vault credits one unit per 10 burned coins, binding each finalized burn receipt to its payer and counting it once. A thousand self-trading aliases cannot mint free trust: 100 extra reputation units still destroy 1,000 coins. There are no signup credits or fee refunds. Privileges must be worth less than their burn cost, or farming remains profitable. Reputation prices influence; it does not prove unique operators.
